estimands.absolute_error: Euclidean distance from prediction to recorded query reference; finite-arm conditional distribution.
estimands.refit_error_benefit: e_frozen - e_refit on finite paired predictions. Positive means lower error under refit.
estimands.quantile_difference: Q(e_frozen) - Q(e_refit) on the identical finite paired population.
estimands.median_paired_difference: median(e_frozen - e_refit), separately calculated; generally differs from the difference of medians.
estimands.net_refit: norm(x_refit - x_own_zero); these magnitudes are not additive.
estimands.affected_population: Selected receiver list intersects field target set; fixed from input identities, never fitted weights or results.
estimands.all_budget_error_benefit: e_10 - e_all on matched source rows and finite budget pairs.
estimands.own_zero_penalty: e_condition - e_own_zero within each budget; positive means worse error than its own zero-map baseline.

inference_limits: All reported field, direction, fold and calibration-realization ranges are descriptive.
Repeated messages, directions, overlapping calibration pools, and limited-budget realizations are not independent deployments.
All-budget fits are retained once per fold; pairwise contrasts against three limited fits do not create three independent all-budget experiments.
Full held-out population eligibility is distinct from sampled-cohort numerical delivery and error distributions.
Every finite-mask exclusion is accompanied by the scheduled/finite count; failures remain in original arrays and exception records.
Primary finite-algorithm outputs are not replaced with numerical audit results; no global optimality claim is made.

calibration_cost.interpretation: Budget10 means10 receptions for each receiver, not10 labeled transmissions overall; source records can support multiple receivers.

ecdf_reconstruction: Every empirical error/exceedance curve is reconstructable from retained prediction arrays and input reference positions. No independent pooled ECDF is asserted.
figure_proposals: Matched frozen/refit error and displacement panels by estimator, magnitude and target set; display the four specified directions.
Spatial-fold calibration-budget panels displaying each limited-budget realization, the one all-budget fit, and each own-zero baseline.
WCL target-weight mass versus prediction movement as mechanism evidence; label as descriptive, not causal regression.
